name: Vango Mining Limited
summary: Vango Mining Limited explores for and develops gold deposits in Australia. Its flagship property is the 100% owned Maymia gold project located in the Yilgarn block of Western Australia. The company was formerly known as Ord River Resources Limited and changed its name to Vango Mining Limited in November 2014. Vango Mining Limited was founded in 2004 and is based in Sydney, Australia.
